prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 中文 · 课程表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 7 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "节次" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 27px
  col 2: header "时间" · longest unbreakable word 44px · one-line width 81px
  col 3: header "周一" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 80px
  col 4: header "周二" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 27px
  col 5: header "周三" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 27px
  col 6: header "周四" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 27px
  col 7: header "周五" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 147px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 480px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 479px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示一周五天各节课的时间和课程，方便查看每日安排及比较同一时段的课程。","reading":"读者可按行查看某一节课在各天的安排，也可沿某一天的列向下查看全天课程；节次和时间共同定位每一行。","groups":["节次、时间：共同标识每一节课。","周一至周五：地位相同的日期列，需要便于横向比较。"],"keep_intact":["节次数字","时间范围，包括起止时间和连接符","简短课程名称，如语文、数学和英语"],"may_wrap":["较长的课程名称可在汉字之间自然换行，例如综合实践活动、信息技术与人工智能。","同一行中较短的课程可利用长课程换行产生的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [48, 102, 75, 50, 50, 50, 104] · table 480×240px · row heights [33, 33, 33, 53, 33, 53] · column headers wrapped 0/7 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [48, 102, 69, 50, 50, 50, 110] · table 480×240px · row heights [33, 33, 33, 53, 33, 53] · column headers wrapped 0/7 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [48, 102, 82, 48, 48, 48, 103] · table 480×240px · row heights [33, 33, 33, 53, 33, 53] · column headers wrapped 0/7 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"节次和时间清楚地共同定位每一行；时间范围完整，所有表头和短课程名称都保持一行。周一和周五的长课程均分为两行，行高节奏一致。","problems":"周五明显宽于其他日期列，横向比较时日期列的节奏稍不均匀；周二至周四较窄，但仍有少量可重新分配的空间。","cause":"周五为104px，以容纳长课程；周二至周四各为50px，相比容纳两字课程所需的宽度略有余量。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"时间范围完整，周五的长课程分为两行；各行仍容易横向阅读。","problems":"周一长课程的换行位置比r1A更零碎，第二行显得偏长；周五更宽也加大了日期列之间的宽度差异。","cause":"周一从75px缩至69px，使第一行能容纳的汉字减少；挪出的6px分配给周五，后者仍需两行。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"时间和短课程保持完整；周一的长课程分为两行，周二至周四宽度一致，日期列的中段节奏紧凑。","problems":"周一比r1A更宽，但长课程仍占两行，额外空间没有改善行高或换行结果；周五长课程仍较紧。","cause":"周一82px仍不足以容纳其最长课程的一行，周五则为103px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[48,102,75,48,48,48,110],"change":"以r1A为基础，将周二至周四各缩小2px，把6px分给周五。保留周一较自然的换行，同时为周五长课程增加空间；三列短课程仍有足够宽度保持一行。"},{"name":"r2B","widths":[48,102,69,48,48,48,116],"change":"以r1B为基础，将周二至周四各缩小2px并分给周五，探索更宽的周五是否能改善最长课程的断行；同时观察周一较窄所带来的代价。"}]}
